about: The planted bugs of the 14 November 2026 measure (seed 20261114; 156 sampled: 102 in 17 named files, 54 one per file elsewhere). Each is one minimal edit of one function: cmp, if, ret, num or call (plant.py). verdict_0_8_2 is what the 0.8.2 suite did with it: caught (a behaviour test failed), gap (no behaviour test failed; digest_only_0_8_2 marks those only the seed digest noticed), equivalent (no behaviour can tell it apart; left out of every rate), void (its run was spoiled by a full disk), not_run (the run was stopped first). group "guarding" is the code that protects the owner: the Kernel, record paths, her hand, the memory and resource rules, change sets, continuing work, the seed and release integrity. modules: the test modules to run, in order; a dotted name runs one class or one test; the first ones are where 0.8.4 put the test written for that bug. verdict_0_8_4: what the 0.8.4 suite did, with the seed made current before each run (run.py): caught, missed, or caught_on_stale_seed (packaging refused the planted tree; a test other than the seed-current one failed); absent: not rerun.

bugs.what: the line's 'take N' refuses take 1 (lower bound 2); only the seed digest notices the edit (sdk/cli/arc1cli/typed_pipeline.py:53)

the line's add expression loses every operator (ops.append deleted), so NAME = a + b is not computed as a sum; no test evaluates an add expression with an operator (sdk/cli/arc1cli/typed_pipeline.py:125)

operator precedence in the line's add expression: '+' gets the precedence of * and /, so 'a + b * c' becomes (a + b) * c; only test_project_desk reaches arithmetic() and no test checks a mixed expression (sdk/cli/arc1cli/typed_pipeline.py:116)

entry_state for a file two or more folders deep: rsplit('/', 2)[0] looks for the temporary file in the wrong folder (same result for one-folder paths), so a staged change in a nested folder reads as PENDING/CONFLICT wrongly; tests use shallow paths only (change_sets.py:269)

bugs.what: the Field's right-click row 'Compare with Rev %s' names the wrong item of the revision pair (other[1], the object, instead of its letter); no test reads that row's words (context_menu.py:1441)
the retry back-off of a failed read step becomes 5*3^n instead of 5*2^n seconds (capped at 60); no test checks retry_at (continuing_work.py:533)

pausing or revoking an adaptive investigation no longer stops its pending branches (stop_pending runs on every other operation instead); no test pauses/revokes a ledger.adaptive-investigation/1 plan and checks its branches (continuing_work.py:724)
a new continuing-work order's agenda row starts with rounds_used=1 instead of 0 (one of its 20 rounds lost); no test reads the fresh row's rounds_used (continuing_work.py:231-232)

plan_variants returns an empty list (no act is offered as a plan choice); no test reads the plan choices built from the exported acts, though the docstring sets rules for them (keyed 'act', flat, within 9,000 bytes) (desk_acts.py:372)
surface() returns None instead of 'home' while Home is in front; no test asserts that the desk reads 'home' (desk_doers.py:180; desk_acts and desk_scenes reach the line)

point_sheet's route is unguarded: with the condition negated, by='keys' selects the sheet directly and the direct route presses keys; both end with the same selection, and no test checks that a sheet chosen 'by keys' was reached by key presses (or 'direct' without them) (desk_doers.py:829)

here_point's fallback empty place in the Files view: the second probe point moves outside the viewport (x = 1.5 x width) and is used when the first probe hits an item; no test fills the lower-right corner so the fallback is never checked (desk_doers.py:972)
the idempotency key's lower bound moves from 1 to 2 characters (a one-character request key is refused); no test submits a one-character key (engineering_kernel.py:1241)

the Field view's face_chosen signal is no longer connected, so choosing a face on the Field itself changes nothing; the desk tests reach the line but change faces another way and never through that signal (field_page.py:57)

bugs.new: not (theirs and theirs['stem'].strip().casefold() == mine['stem'].strip().casefold() and theirs['rev'].casefold() != mine['rev'].casefold())

bugs.what: reviewed_rows returns None instead of [] when office.get is refused, which its callers would iterate; no test opens a Field sheet whose office record cannot be read (field_page.py:715)
opening an object from the Field no longer leaves the Field (leave_field is called only when nothing opened); no test checks what the centre shows after an open from the Field (field_page.py:684)

cells_named on a sheet: negated, a Field sheet yields no cell names (and a non-sheet object is read as a sheet); no test checks the names field_ripple collects from a sheet (field_ripple.py:71; only test_desk_acts runs it)

field_ripple._read always answers None, so no record is ever read for a ripple; with M051/M053 this shows that nothing asserts what field_ripple computes, only that it does not crash (field_ripple.py:39)

number(): negated, a numeric cell is passed through only when it is NOT a number, so text cells such as '1,234' or '12' are no longer read as numbers (and bools become text); six modules reach it but none asserts a text cell read as a number (files_service.py:259)
the file diff numbers every added line one too high ('after': j + 2); test_context_menu shows a diff but never checks an added line's number (files_service.py:331)
the line preview's 'long column' threshold moves from 24 to 25 characters on average; no test offers a column at the threshold (line_steps.py:242)

bugs.what: each resident-model commitment adds at least one byte to the reserved future (max(1, ...)); no test checks reserved_future_bytes exactly when budgets are fully used (resource_control.py:172)

reserve_setting(kernel) without a connection returns None, so starting a model (local_brain.py:509, brain_qt.py:82, worker_boundary.py:408) silently uses the default foreground reserve instead of the owner's; tests keep the default reserve, so the owner's value is never checked on that path (resource_control.py:62)

the one-coordinator rule: with == flipped, a control job no longer waits for another control job, and inference/compute work waits while any control job runs; no test runs two control jobs or control beside other lanes (resource_control.py:187)

memory view: negated, a live resident model worker's reservation is dropped from the commitments (and a loading or excluded one is counted); test_resource_rules reaches the line with a live worker but never asserts the resident model's row or the 'future' total (resource_control.py:167)

the 32,000,000-byte bound on a project prerequisite becomes 32,000,001; only the seed digest notices (stacy_foundation.py:256); re-run beside an unmutated control: the mutant fails test_every_navigation_changes_nothing again with 'offers no rows to keep', the control passes (recheck.json)
